observations: Frame: the design puts USB at +X and the jack at -X (180 deg about Z from the requirements frame); normalised, not penalised. The V3 grading delta 'jack mouth X in [79.5, 81.0]' is met in the normalised frame (x' = 80.0).

Thin margins (pass, no tolerance left for print error): lid lip bottom Z 23.1 is 0.10 above the 23.0 top keep-out; floor top Z -5.7 is 0.10 below the -5.6 bottom keep-out; walls' inner faces are 0.10 from the Ø7 screw-head columns.
Layout: capacitor (X 14.5-24.5) is 0.16 mm from the Pico PCB edge (X 24.66) in plan; no interference, but tight for real hand assembly.

Corner lid bosses (OD 6.6 centred at (-3.287,-3.287) etc.) stand outside the walls as external columns and intrude 0.15 mm into the inner corners of the cavity (boss surface at about (-0.95,-0.95) vs wall inner corner (-1.1,-1.1)); the lid lip is notched (Ø7.11) to clear them. No check affected.

Renders appear to use an elevated perspective camera, so the 'front/left/right' views show the lid top obliquely; the closed render shows no standoffs because they are hidden under the board (they exist in the STL).
